en: Black‑and‑white image showing a grassy field with several children or youths standing apart, possibly playing. In the background on the right is a medium‑sized Gothic‑revival church with pointed-arch windows, steep tiled roof, and a slender spire topped by a cross. To the left are a few multi‑story residential or civic buildings with simple 19th‑century Central European architecture, plus lower farm-like or school buildings with hipped roofs. The scene suggests a small European town or village; there is no visible printed text on the front.
